verdict.rationale: Codegen exposes a Python SDK and REST API using an org_id + single token model (codegen-docs-15/16), and has agent-permission settings for repo actions like signed commits (codegen-docs-25), but there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege API credentials/tokens (e.g., token scopes, role-based keys, restricted-permission tokens) that a user could issue for an agent. Missing for 10: any documentation of token scoping, permission levels for API keys, or least-privilege credential issuance mechanism.
